column3: "enforces the battle lines". the main frontline, enforcers mark where each team should be in a fight and are the ones to start it. they create the space for the rest of their team to capitalize
"duel opponents". duelists main job is to pick their target and kill it. they can do this either supported by their team, or alone. excel at 1v1

"control the enemy's options". either via debuffs, taxing, crowd control, area damage, or any other means, the job of a controller is to dictate what the opponent can and can't do, while sometimes giving support to their own team

"fixes the match in their favour". a fixer can come in many shapes and sizes. either not proficient in combat but with an arsenal of supporting utility, or increasing board presence, they provide serious value to a win
